title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Maya Singh
description:
Motivation: ship canonical RAG/agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples for the examples repo and docs site. This PR adds opinionated RAG templates (retriever + agent orchestration), a set of tool-calling sample agents (HTTP integrator, calendar lookup, file search), and syncs quickstart pages for the docs site. Goal is to provide teams with drop-in examples that demonstrate best-practices for prompt templates, KV/prefix caching considerations, and safe tool invocation patterns.

What this includes: checklist:
- [x] RAG templates (templates/md + templates/json) with placeholders for retriever config and chunking settings
- [x] Agent tool-calling samples in Python and TypeScript (http_integration, calendar_agent, file_search_agent)
- [x] Quickstart docs for redwood-docs (docs/rag/quickstarts.md) with step-by-step instructions and expected responses
- [x] Example eval prompts and a small harness that can be run locally to validate regressions
- [x] Docs site nav update and links to new example notebooks

Compatibility notes: templates target the public Redwood SDKs (python/ts) and include minimal config that works against hosted API and dedicated stacks. Tool calling examples use the standard function-calling shape used across SDKs and include explicit retry/backoff guidance. No breaking API changes.

Testing: added unit tests for the sample agents (simple mock retriever + fake HTTP server), smoke run in CI to ensure docs build and examples execute. Manual testing notes included in PR comments.

Release notes: Add RAG/agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples. Useful for onboarding and reference apps.

Follow-ups: add a short recorded walkthrough for the examples (ENG-4822) and expand the eval harness into a small benchmark job (ENG-4823).
